en.headline: Passengers steer taxi after driver faints on Ching Cheung Road
en.dek: Four passengers were unhurt after a 66-year-old taxi driver lost consciousness near noon on Monday; local reports said he remained in a critical condition.
body: Four passengers escaped injury after a taxi driver lost consciousness while travelling eastbound on Ching Cheung Road near Nob Hill in Cheung Sha Wan at about noon on Monday, according to local media reports published late on Wednesday.

Dashcam footage circulating online showed the 66-year-old driver, surnamed Li, slumped at the wheel as a male passenger in the front seat and three women in the back tried to rouse him. Reports said the ordeal lasted more than 30 seconds before a passenger pulled the handbrake and the taxi scraped a roadside divider and stopped. The vehicle was left with a burst front tyre but no obvious bodywork damage.

Emergency responders found the driver unconscious. He was taken to hospital with no visible injuries. The South China Morning Post later reported that he remained in a critical condition. Police were alerted by one of the women on board. No passenger injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 呈祥道的士司機昏迷 乘客協助停車無人受傷
zh.dek: 周一中午66歲司機在長沙灣呈祥道近樂軒臺一帶突然失去知覺，四名乘客無羔；報道指司機其後情況危殆。
body: 本地傳媒周三晚報道，周一中午約12時，一輛的士沿呈祥道東行駛至近樂軒臺時，66歲姓李司機突然昏迷，車上四名乘客最終無人受傷。
網上流出的行車記錄儀片段顯示，司機一開始已低頭不醒，前座男乘客及後座三名女乘客拍其面部及肩腦，試圖叫醒他但不成功。報道指過程超過30秒，其後有乘客拉起手描，的士擦撞石壤後停下，車頭輪胎爆裂，躺身未見明顯損毀。
救援人員到場時司機仍然昏迷，送院時體表未見外傷。《南華早報》其後報道他情況危殆。警方由其中一名女乘客報案。四名乘客均無受傷。
